passage.label: Indeed We sent down you Muhammad Quran progressively; patient decision Lord do not obey among sinner ungrateful disbeliever; mention name Lord morning evening; during night prostrate exalt long part night

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَنزِيلٗا
فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ ءَاثِمًا أَوۡ كَفُورٗا
وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَٱسۡجُدۡ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلٗا طَوِيلًا

mainSubject.label: The progressive sending-down of the Quran to the Prophet affirmed; patience commanded for the Lord's decision with prohibition of obeying any sinner or ungrateful disbeliever; remembrance of the Lord's name morning and evening joined to night prostration and prolonged exaltation

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ ءَاثِمًا أَوۡ كَفُورٗا
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Be patient for the decision of your Lord.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ ءَاثِمًا أَوۡ كَفُورٗا
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful disbeliever.
Mention the name of your Lord morning and evening.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَٱسۡجُدۡ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلٗا طَوِيلًا
commandsAndProhibitions.description: During the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long part of the night.

notes: Wave 11 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the disbelievers' chains-shackles-blaze preparation (4) before the righteous-reward block opens (5); P2 ends with the earned-reward declaration (22) before the progressive-Quran and prophetic-instruction block begins (23); P3 covers the tanzil, patience command, dhikr and night worship (23-26); P4 runs through the immediate-love diagnosis, creation-alteration power, reminder function, divine-will nesting and closing mercy-punishment distinction (27-31).
